name: engineering-excellence
description: Encode invariants in types and contracts, preserve established proofs, and make illegal states unrepresentable.

metadata.dailyDriver: Use for contract-first domain design, proof-loss review, closed failures, and state transitions. Includes Kotlin, API, and shell examples; select implementation specialties as needed.
metadata.notFor: Git, pull requests, CI operations, automatic proof-loss analysis, or a claim that the compiler proves all runtime behavior.
metadata.scope: Preserve domain knowledge in mechanically enforced representations and reject invalid compositions at the strongest available boundary.
